title: Vickers Wellington HE702
memorial_details: A ground supported, portrait orientated metal plaque. Painted white and with a thin black lined border surrounding, at top the unit badge of 199 Squadron Royal Air Force, and beneath, written in Dutch the dedication and names and details of the crew.
inscription: [199 Squadron badge]/ Ter nagedachtenis aan de bemanning van de Vickers-Wellington HE-702/ 199 Squadron RAF/ (Names)/ Omgekomen in de vroege morgen van 13 mei 1943/ yijdens een ombardementsvlucht van Ingham naar Duisburg/ "Into the dark night they flew and on to the glorius morn"/ ‘Translated as’ In memory of the crew of the Vickers-Wellington HE-702/ 199 Squadron RAF/ (Names)/ Died in the early morning of May 13, 1943/ during a bombing flight from Ingham to Duisburg/ "Into the dark night they flew and on to the glorius morn"
custodian: Polish Bomber Squadrons Centre RAF Ingham
